translations.q008: WITH user_activity AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits GROUP BY UserID), top_users AS (SELECT UserID, active_days, hits_cnt FROM user_activity ORDER BY active_days DESC, hits_cnt DESC, UserID LIMIT 20), user_os AS (SELECT UserID, OS, COUNT(*) AS os_hits FROM hits WHERE UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM top_users) GROUP BY UserID, OS), os_ranked AS (SELECT UserID, OS, os_hits, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY os_hits DESC, OS) AS rn FROM user_os) SELECT t.UserID, t.active_days, t.hits_cnt, o.OS AS main_os, o.os_hits FROM top_users t JOIN os_ranked o ON t.UserID = o.UserID WHERE o.rn = 1 ORDER BY t.active_days DESC, t.hits_cnt DESC, t.UserID
translations.q009: SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT 20 * AVG(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID) t) ORDER BY hits DESC, CounterID LIMIT 25
translations.q010: SELECT OS, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN MobilePhone > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS phone_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN CookieEnable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nocookie_hits FROM hits WHERE OS IN (SELECT OS FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OS FROM hits WHERE MobilePhone > 0 INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT OS FROM hits WHERE CookieEnable = 0) x) GROUP BY OS ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, OS LIMIT 25
translations.q011: WITH daily AS (SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS total_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN IsMobile = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mobile_hits FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate) SELECT EventDate, mobile_hits, total_hits, CAST(mobile_hits AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(total_hits, 0) AS mobile_share, mobile_hits - (SELECT AVG(mobile_hits) FROM daily) AS vs_avg_mobile, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY mobile_hits DESC) AS mobile_rank FROM daily ORDER BY EventDate
translations.q012: WITH nd AS (SELECT CAST(FLOOR(CAST(ClientIP AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 65536) AS BIGINT) AS ip16, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS d, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits GROUP BY ip16, d) SELECT n.ip16, SUM(n.hit_count) AS early_hits, COUNT(*) AS early_days FROM nd n WHERE n.d <= 3 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nd m WHERE m.ip16 = n.ip16 AND m.d >= 29) GROUP BY n.ip16 ORDER BY early_hits DESC, n.ip16 LIMIT 20
translations.q013: SELECT LOWER(SUBSTRING(BrowserLanguage, 1, 2)) AS lang_prefix, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN SearchEngineID <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS search_hits FROM hits WHERE BrowserLanguage <> '' GROUP BY LOWER(SUBSTRING(BrowserLanguage, 1, 2)) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 ORDER BY users_cnt DESC, hits_cnt DESC, lang_prefix LIMIT 15
translations.q014: WITH src AS (SELECT OpenstatSourceID, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_cnt FROM hits WHERE OpenstatSourceID <> '' GROUP BY OpenstatSourceID), src_os AS (SELECT OpenstatSourceID, OS, COUNT(*) AS os_hits, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OpenstatSourceID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, OS) AS rn FROM hits WHERE OpenstatSourceID <> '' GROUP BY OpenstatSourceID, OS) SELECT s.OpenstatSourceID, s.hits_cnt, s.users_cnt, o.OS AS top_os, CAST(o.os_hits AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / s.hits_cnt AS top_os_share FROM src s JOIN src_os o ON s.OpenstatSourceID = o.OpenstatSourceID WHERE o.rn = 1 ORDER BY s.hits_cnt DESC, s.users_cnt DESC, s.OpenstatSourceID LIMIT 15
translations.q015: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OS, ResolutionDepth FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-16' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT OS, ResolutionDepth FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-16') a) AS only_first_half, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OS, ResolutionDepth FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-16' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT OS, ResolutionDepth FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-16') b) AS only_second_half, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OS, ResolutionDepth FROM hits) c) AS all_pairs ORDER BY only_first_half
translations.q016: SELECT day_of_month, new_ips, one_hit_ips, SUM(new_ips) OVER (ORDER BY day_of_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_ips FROM (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM first_day) AS INTEGER) AS day_of_month, COUNT(*) AS new_ips, SUM(CASE WHEN total_hits = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS one_hit_ips FROM (SELECT ClientIP, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day, COUNT(*) AS total_hits FROM hits GROUP BY ClientIP) t GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM first_day) AS INTEGER)) d ORDER BY day_of_month
translations.q017: SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hits, AVG(CHAR_LENGTH(Title)) AS avg_title_len, MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(Title)) AS max_title_len, COUNT(DISTINCT Title) AS titles FROM hits WHERE Title <> '' AND CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY c DESC, CounterID LIMIT 10) t) GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY avg_title_len DESC, CounterID
translations.q018: WITH hourly AS (SELECT TraficSourceID, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS avg_rst FROM hits GROUP BY TraficSourceID, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100), ranked AS (SELECT TraficSourceID, hr, hits_cnt, avg_rst, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TraficSourceID ORDER BY avg_rst DESC, hr) AS rn FROM hourly) SELECT TraficSourceID, hr, hits_cnt, ROUND(avg_rst, 2) AS avg_rst_ms, rn FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY TraficSourceID, rn
translations.q019: SELECT CASE WHEN h.IsMobile = 1 THEN 'mobile' ELSE 'desktop' END AS device, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users_cnt, AVG(h.WindowClientWidth) AS avg_width FROM hits h WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits g WHERE g.UserID = h.UserID AND g.HasGCLID = 1) GROUP BY h.IsMobile ORDER BY device
translations.q020: WITH vis AS (SELECT RegionID AS reg, COUNT(*) AS visitor_hits FROM hits GROUP BY RegionID), ref AS (SELECT RefererRegionID AS reg, COUNT(*) AS referer_hits FROM hits WHERE RefererRegionID <> 0 GROUP BY RefererRegionID), k AS (SELECT reg FROM (SELECT reg FROM vis UNION ALL SELECT reg FROM ref) x GROUP BY reg) SELECT k.reg, COALESCE(v.visitor_hits, 0) AS visitor_hits, COALESCE(f.referer_hits, 0) AS referer_hits, COALESCE(v.visitor_hits, 0) + COALESCE(f.referer_hits, 0) AS total_hits FROM k LEFT JOIN vis v ON k.reg = v.reg LEFT JOIN ref f ON k.reg = f.reg ORDER BY total_hits DESC, k.reg LIMIT 30
translations.q021: WITH first_seen AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID), weekly AS (SELECT CAST(FLOOR(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) - 1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 7) AS INTEGER) + 1 AS wk, COUNT(*) AS hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY CAST(FLOOR(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) - 1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 7) AS INTEGER) + 1), newbies AS (SELECT CAST(FLOOR(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM first_day) - 1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 7) AS INTEGER) + 1 AS wk, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM first_seen GROUP BY CAST(FLOOR(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM first_day) - 1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 7) AS INTEGER) + 1) SELECT w.wk, w.hits, w.users, COALESCE(n.new_users, 0) AS new_users, CAST(COALESCE(n.new_users, 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(w.users, 0) AS new_user_share FROM weekly w LEFT JOIN newbies n ON n.wk = w.wk ORDER BY w.wk
translations.q022: SELECT SUBSTRING(URL, 1, 25) AS url_prefix, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ClientIP) AS ips FROM hits WHERE ClientIP IN (SELECT ClientIP FROM (SELECT ClientIP, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS u FROM hits GROUP BY ClientIP ORDER BY u DESC, ClientIP LIMIT 10) t) AND URL <> '' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(URL, 1, 25) ORDER BY hit_count DESC, url_prefix LIMIT 30
translations.q023: SELECT h.EventDate, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS lapsed_searchers, COUNT(*) AS search_hits FROM hits h WHERE h.SearchPhrase <> '' AND h.EventDate BETWEEN DATE '2013-07-01' AND DATE '2013-07-07' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits l WHERE l.UserID = h.UserID AND l.EventDate >= DATE '2013-07-15') GROUP BY h.EventDate ORDER BY h.EventDate
translations.q024: WITH user_counter AS (SELECT CounterID, UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID, UserID), counter_stats AS (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(CASE WHEN active_days >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ret_users FROM user_counter GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100) SELECT FLOOR(CAST(ret_users * 10 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / users) AS retention_decile, COUNT(*) AS counters, SUM(users) AS users_total FROM counter_stats GROUP BY retention_decile ORDER BY retention_decile
translations.q025: WITH top_counter AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1), seq AS (SELECT UserID, EventTime, LEAD(EventTime) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS nxt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime DESC, WatchID DESC) AS rn_desc FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM top_counter) AND EventDate >= '2013-07-01' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-31'), gaps AS (SELECT (EXTRACT(DAY FROM nxt) - EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventTime)) * 86400 + (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM nxt) - EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)) * 3600 + (EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM nxt) - EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM EventTime)) * 60 + (EXTRACT(SECOND FROM nxt) - EXTRACT(SECOND FROM EventTime)) AS gap FROM seq WHERE rn_desc > 1) SELECT CASE WHEN gap < 10 THEN 1 WHEN gap < 60 THEN 2 WHEN gap < 3600 THEN 3 WHEN gap < 86400 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS gap_band, COUNT(*) AS n FROM gaps GROUP BY CASE WHEN gap < 10 THEN 1 WHEN gap < 60 THEN 2 WHEN gap < 3600 THEN 3 WHEN gap < 86400 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END ORDER BY gap_band
translations.q026: SELECT OS, ResolutionDepth, hits_cnt, rn FROM (SELECT OS, ResolutionDepth, hits_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OS ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, ResolutionDepth) AS rn FROM (SELECT OS, ResolutionDepth, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits WHERE OS IN (SELECT OS FROM hits GROUP BY OS ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, OS LIMIT 10) GROUP BY OS, ResolutionDepth) a) t WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY OS, rn
translations.q027: SELECT SearchEngineID, COUNT(*) AS searches, COUNT(DISTINCT SearchPhrase) AS phrases, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS searchers, SUM(CASE WHEN SearchPhrase LIKE '% % %' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS long_queries, MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(SearchPhrase)) AS max_len FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY SearchEngineID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY searches DESC, SearchEngineID LIMIT 20
translations.q028: WITH only_search AS (SELECT BrowserCountry FROM hits WHERE SearchEngineID <> 0 AND BrowserCountry <> '' GROUP BY BrowserCountry EXCEPT SELECT BrowserCountry FROM hits WHERE UTMSource <> '' GROUP BY BrowserCountry) SELECT h.BrowserCountry, COUNT(*) AS search_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS search_users FROM hits h JOIN only_search o ON h.BrowserCountry = o.BrowserCountry WHERE h.SearchEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY h.BrowserCountry ORDER BY search_hits DESC, search_users DESC, h.BrowserCountry LIMIT 20
translations.q029: WITH h AS (SELECT NetMajor AS nm, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(DISTINCT ClientIP) AS ips, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 1 GROUP BY NetMajor, hr) SELECT nm, hr, ips, hit_count FROM (SELECT nm, hr, ips, hit_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY nm ORDER BY ips DESC, hit_count DESC, hr) AS rn FROM h) t WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY nm, rn LIMIT 100
translations.q030: WITH cs AS (SELECT CounterID, AVG(FetchTiming) AS avg_f, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000), outl AS (SELECT h.CounterID, COUNT(*) AS slow_cnt FROM hits h JOIN cs ON h.CounterID = cs.CounterID WHERE h.FetchTiming > 3 * cs.avg_f GROUP BY h.CounterID) SELECT cs.CounterID, cs.hits_cnt, o.slow_cnt, CAST(o.slow_cnt AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(cs.hits_cnt, 0) AS slow_share FROM cs JOIN outl o ON cs.CounterID = o.CounterID ORDER BY slow_share DESC, cs.CounterID LIMIT 20
translations.q031: WITH trav AS (SELECT UserID FROM hits GROUP BY UserID ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT RegionID) DESC, UserID LIMIT 10) SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS n_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN rn > 1 AND prev_region <> RegionID THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS region_switches FROM (SELECT UserID, RegionID, LAG(RegionID) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS prev_region, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) AS rn FROM hits WHERE UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM trav)) t GROUP BY UserID ORDER BY region_switches DESC, UserID
translations.q032: SELECT metric, hits_cnt, nonzero_hits, avg_ms, max_ms FROM (SELECT 'dns' AS metric, 1 AS ord, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN DNSTiming > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonzero_hits, ROUND(AVG(DNSTiming), 2) AS avg_ms, MAX(DNSTiming) AS max_ms FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-08' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-21' UNION ALL SELECT 'connect', 2, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN ConnectTiming > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ROUND(AVG(ConnectTiming), 2), MAX(ConnectTiming) FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-08' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-21' UNION ALL SELECT 'send', 3, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN SendTiming > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ROUND(AVG(SendTiming), 2), MAX(SendTiming) FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-08' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-21' UNION ALL SELECT 'response_start', 4, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN ResponseStartTiming > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ROUND(AVG(ResponseStartTiming), 2), MAX(ResponseStartTiming) FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-08' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-21' UNION ALL SELECT 'response_end', 5, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN ResponseEndTiming > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ROUND(AVG(ResponseEndTiming), 2), MAX(ResponseEndTiming) FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-08' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-21' UNION ALL SELECT 'fetch', 6, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN FetchTiming > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ROUND(AVG(FetchTiming), 2), MAX(FetchTiming) FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-08' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-21') m ORDER BY ord
translations.q033: WITH daily AS (SELECT TraficSourceID, EventDate, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM hits GROUP BY TraficSourceID, EventDate) SELECT d.TraficSourceID, d.EventDate, d.hits FROM daily d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM daily p WHERE p.TraficSourceID = d.TraficSourceID AND p.EventDate < d.EventDate AND p.hits >= d.hits) ORDER BY d.TraficSourceID, d.EventDate LIMIT 100
translations.q034: WITH per_user AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT ClientIP) AS ips FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) SELECT COUNT(*) AS heavy_users, COALESCE(SUM(c), 0) AS heavy_hits, COALESCE(MAX(c), 0) AS max_hits, COALESCE(MAX(ips), 0) AS max_ips FROM per_user WHERE c > 50 * (SELECT AVG(c) FROM per_user) ORDER BY heavy_users
translations.q035: SELECT CounterClass, CounterID, hits_cnt, avg_fetch_ms, rn FROM (SELECT CounterClass, CounterID, hits_cnt, avg_fetch_ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CounterClass ORDER BY avg_fetch DESC, CounterID) AS rn FROM (SELECT CounterClass, CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, AVG(FetchTiming) AS avg_fetch, ROUND(AVG(FetchTiming), 2) AS avg_fetch_ms FROM hits GROUP BY CounterClass, CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000) a) t WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY CounterClass, rn LIMIT 100
translations.q036: WITH daily AS (SELECT RegionID, EventDate, COUNT(*) AS n FROM hits GROUP BY RegionID, EventDate), stats AS (SELECT RegionID, MAX(n) AS mx, SUM(n) AS tot, COUNT(*) AS days FROM daily GROUP BY RegionID), bursty AS (SELECT RegionID FROM stats WHERE days >= 3 AND mx * 2 > tot) SELECT d.RegionID AS region, d.EventDate AS burst_day, d.n AS burst_hits, s.tot AS region_hits, s.days AS active_days FROM daily d JOIN stats s ON d.RegionID = s.RegionID WHERE d.n = s.mx AND d.RegionID IN (SELECT RegionID FROM bursty) ORDER BY burst_hits DESC, region, burst_day LIMIT 30
translations.q037: SELECT first_char, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT FromTag) AS tags, ROUND(AVG(CHAR_LENGTH(FromTag)), 2) AS avg_len FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN FromTag = '' THEN '(none)' ELSE UPPER(SUBSTRING(FromTag, 1, 1)) END AS first_char, FromTag FROM hits) t GROUP BY first_char ORDER BY hit_count DESC, first_char LIMIT 20
translations.q038: WITH lagoon AS (SELECT ClientIP FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY ClientIP INTERSECT SELECT ClientIP FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 0 AND ResolutionWidth >= 1600 GROUP BY ClientIP) SELECT h.ClientIP, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users, SUM(h.IsMobile) AS mobile_hits FROM hits h JOIN lagoon l ON h.ClientIP = l.ClientIP GROUP BY h.ClientIP ORDER BY hit_count DESC, h.ClientIP LIMIT 20
translations.q039: WITH daily AS (SELECT UserAgent, EventDate, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM hits GROUP BY UserAgent, EventDate) SELECT d.UserAgent, COUNT(*) AS strong_days, MAX(d.hits) AS peak_hits, MIN(d.EventDate) AS first_strong_day FROM daily d WHERE d.hits > 1.2 * (SELECT AVG(d2.hits) FROM daily d2 WHERE d2.UserAgent = d.UserAgent) GROUP BY d.UserAgent ORDER BY strong_days DESC, d.UserAgent LIMIT 20
translations.q040: WITH g AS (SELECT UserAgent, UserAgentMinor, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE UserAgentMinor <> '' GROUP BY UserAgent, UserAgentMinor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5), r AS (SELECT UserAgent, UserAgentMinor, c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserAgent ORDER BY c, UserAgentMinor) AS rn FROM g) SELECT UserAgent, UserAgentMinor, c, rn FROM r WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY UserAgent, rn LIMIT 100
translations.q041: WITH hourly AS (SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN HasGCLID = 1 THEN UserID END) AS gclid_users, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS avg_rst FROM hits GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)) SELECT cur.hr AS hour_of_day, cur.hits_cnt AS hits_in_hour, cur.gclid_users AS gclid_users_in_hour, ROUND(cur.avg_rst, 2) AS avg_rst_ms, ROUND(cur.avg_rst - prev.avg_rst, 2) AS delta_vs_prev_hour FROM hourly cur JOIN hourly prev ON cur.hr = prev.hr + 1 ORDER BY hour_of_day
translations.q042: SELECT h.MobilePhone, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits h WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits d WHERE d.UserID = h.UserID AND d.IsDownload = 1) GROUP BY h.MobilePhone ORDER BY users DESC, hit_count DESC, h.MobilePhone LIMIT 30
translations.q043: WITH langs AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage FROM hits WHERE MobilePhone > 0 GROUP BY BrowserLanguage INTERSECT SELECT BrowserLanguage FROM hits WHERE SilverlightVersion3 > 0 GROUP BY BrowserLanguage) SELECT b.BrowserLanguage, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.UserID) AS users FROM hits b WHERE b.BrowserLanguage IN (SELECT BrowserLanguage FROM langs) GROUP BY b.BrowserLanguage ORDER BY hit_count DESC, b.BrowserLanguage LIMIT 30
translations.q044: SELECT UTMMedium, local_hour, hits_cnt FROM (SELECT UTMMedium, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime) AS local_hour, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UTMMedium ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime)) AS rn FROM hits WHERE UTMMedium <> '' GROUP BY UTMMedium, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime)) t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, UTMMedium LIMIT 20
translations.q045: WITH ranked AS (SELECT UserID, TraficSourceID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID, TraficSourceID) AS rn FROM hits), first_touch AS (SELECT UserID, TraficSourceID FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1), activity AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) SELECT f.TraficSourceID, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(CASE WHEN a.active_days >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned_users, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.active_days >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS return_rate FROM first_touch f JOIN activity a ON f.UserID = a.UserID GROUP BY f.TraficSourceID ORDER BY users DESC, f.TraficSourceID
translations.q046: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, SUM(IsRefresh) AS refreshes FROM hits WHERE EventDate = (SELECT EventDate FROM (SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate ORDER BY c DESC, EventDate LIMIT 1) b) GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) ORDER BY hr
translations.q047: SELECT m.MobilePhone, COUNT(DISTINCT m.UserID) AS flashless_users, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits m WHERE m.IsMobile = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits f WHERE f.UserID = m.UserID AND f.FlashMinor2 <> '') GROUP BY m.MobilePhone ORDER BY flashless_users DESC, hits_cnt DESC, m.MobilePhone LIMIT 25
translations.q048: WITH t AS (SELECT IsMobile, Title, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS avg_rst FROM hits WHERE Title <> '' GROUP BY IsMobile, Title HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200), r AS (SELECT IsMobile, Title, hits_cnt, avg_rst, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY IsMobile ORDER BY avg_rst DESC, hits_cnt DESC, Title) AS rn FROM t) SELECT IsMobile, Title, hits_cnt, ROUND(avg_rst, 2) AS avg_rst_ms, rn FROM r WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY IsMobile, rn
translations.q049: SELECT first_day, CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM first_day) - 1) % 7 IN (5, 6) THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'weekday' END AS day_kind, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) t GROUP BY first_day ORDER BY first_day
translations.q050: SELECT UPPER(SUBSTRING(BrowserLanguage, 1, 2)) AS lang_code, COUNT(*) AS desktop_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS cross_device_users FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 0 AND BrowserLanguage <> '' AND UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1) GROUP BY UPPER(SUBSTRING(BrowserLanguage, 1, 2)) ORDER BY cross_device_users DESC, desktop_hits DESC, lang_code LIMIT 20
translations.q051: WITH s AS (SELECT IsMobile, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN JavascriptEnable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS js_off, SUM(HasGCLID) AS gclid, SUM(IsRefresh) AS refreshes, SUM(IsNotBounce) AS engaged FROM hits GROUP BY IsMobile) SELECT ord, metric, IsMobile, rate FROM (SELECT 1 AS ord, 'javascript_off' AS metric, IsMobile, CAST(js_off AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(n, 0) AS rate FROM s UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS ord, 'gclid' AS metric, IsMobile, CAST(gclid AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(n, 0) AS rate FROM s UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS ord, 'refresh' AS metric, IsMobile, CAST(refreshes AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(n, 0) AS rate FROM s UNION ALL SELECT 4 AS ord, 'not_bounce' AS metric, IsMobile, CAST(engaged AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(n, 0) AS rate FROM s) r ORDER BY ord, IsMobile
translations.q052: WITH by_src AS (SELECT EventDate, TraficSourceID, COUNT(*) AS src_hits FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, TraficSourceID), by_day AS (SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS day_hits FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate), shares AS (SELECT s.TraficSourceID AS src_id, s.EventDate AS day_date, s.src_hits AS src_hits, d.day_hits AS day_hits, CAST(s.src_hits AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / d.day_hits AS day_share FROM by_src s JOIN by_day d ON s.EventDate = d.EventDate), ranked AS (SELECT src_id, day_date, src_hits, day_hits, day_share, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY src_id ORDER BY day_share DESC, day_date) AS rn FROM shares) SELECT src_id, day_date, src_hits, day_hits, day_share FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY src_id
translations.q053: SELECT h.EventDate, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS adv_searchers, COUNT(*) AS adv_hits FROM hits h WHERE h.AdvEngineID <> 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits s WHERE s.UserID = h.UserID AND s.EventDate = h.EventDate AND s.SearchPhrase <> '') GROUP BY h.EventDate ORDER BY h.EventDate
translations.q054: SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM first_day) AS INTEGER) AS day_of_july, new_users, SUM(new_users) OVER (ORDER BY first_day) AS cumulative_users FROM (SELECT first_day, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) u GROUP BY first_day) d ORDER BY first_day
translations.q055: SELECT OS, COUNT(*) AS total_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN JavascriptEnable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nojs_hits, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN JavascriptEnable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hits WHERE JavascriptEnable = 0), 0) AS share_of_nojs FROM hits GROUP BY OS HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY nojs_hits DESC, OS LIMIT 15
translations.q056: WITH mob AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS m_hits, SUM(ConnectTiming) AS m_conn FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY UserID), desk AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS d_hits, SUM(ConnectTiming) AS d_conn FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 0 GROUP BY UserID) SELECT CASE WHEN m.m_conn * d.d_hits > d.d_conn * m.m_hits THEN 1 WHEN m.m_conn * d.d_hits < d.d_conn * m.m_hits THEN -1 ELSE 0 END AS verdict, COUNT(*) AS users_cnt, SUM(m.m_hits) AS mobile_hits, SUM(d.d_hits) AS desktop_hits FROM mob m JOIN desk d ON m.UserID = d.UserID GROUP BY CASE WHEN m.m_conn * d.d_hits > d.d_conn * m.m_hits THEN 1 WHEN m.m_conn * d.d_hits < d.d_conn * m.m_hits THEN -1 ELSE 0 END ORDER BY verdict
translations.q057: SELECT CAST(FLOOR(CAST(CHAR_LENGTH(Title) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 20) AS INTEGER) * 20 AS len_from, COUNT(*) AS hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, AVG(ResolutionDepth) AS avg_depth FROM hits WHERE Title <> '' GROUP BY CAST(FLOOR(CAST(CHAR_LENGTH(Title) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 20) AS INTEGER) * 20 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY len_from LIMIT 50
translations.q058: SELECT column_name, distinct_values, filled_hits FROM (SELECT 'UTMMedium' AS column_name, COUNT(DISTINCT UTMMedium) AS distinct_values, SUM(CASE WHEN UTMMedium <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS filled_hits FROM hits UNION ALL SELECT 'OpenstatCampaignID' AS column_name, COUNT(DISTINCT OpenstatCampaignID) AS distinct_values, SUM(CASE WHEN OpenstatCampaignID <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS filled_hits FROM hits UNION ALL SELECT 'FlashMinor2' AS column_name, COUNT(DISTINCT FlashMinor2) AS distinct_values, SUM(CASE WHEN FlashMinor2 <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS filled_hits FROM hits UNION ALL SELECT 'MobilePhoneModel' AS column_name, COUNT(DISTINCT MobilePhoneModel) AS distinct_values, SUM(CASE WHEN MobilePhoneModel <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS filled_hits FROM hits) u ORDER BY column_name
translations.q059: SELECT m.EventDate, COUNT(*) AS mobile_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT m.ClientIP) AS shared_ips FROM hits m WHERE m.IsMobile = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits d WHERE d.IsMobile = 0 AND d.ClientIP = m.ClientIP AND d.EventDate = m.EventDate) GROUP BY m.EventDate ORDER BY m.EventDate
translations.q060: SELECT first_tz, COUNT(*) AS users FROM (SELECT UserID, MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc = 1 THEN ClientTimeZone END) AS first_tz, MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN ClientTimeZone END) AS last_tz FROM (SELECT UserID, ClientTimeZone, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) AS rn_asc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime DESC, WatchID DESC) AS rn_desc FROM hits) s GROUP BY UserID) u WHERE first_tz <> last_tz GROUP BY first_tz ORDER BY users DESC, first_tz LIMIT 30
translations.q061: SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN JavaEnable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS java_off_share FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 AND CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN JavaEnable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) > (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN JavaEnable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) FROM hits) ORDER BY java_off_share DESC, CounterID LIMIT 20
translations.q062: WITH hourly AS (SELECT EventDate AS day_date, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime) AS local_hour, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, AVG(FetchTiming) AS avg_fetch FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime)), ranked AS (SELECT day_date, local_hour, hits_cnt, avg_fetch, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY day_date ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, local_hour) AS rn FROM hourly) SELECT day_date, local_hour, hits_cnt, ROUND(avg_fetch, 2) AS avg_fetch_ms FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY day_date
translations.q063: SELECT metric, users FROM (SELECT 'flash_users' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE FlashMajor > 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'silverlight_users' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE SilverlightVersion1 > 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'nojs_users' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE JavascriptEnable = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'refreshing_users' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'all_users' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DontCountHits = 0 THEN UserID END) AS users FROM hits) k ORDER BY users DESC, metric
translations.q064: WITH u AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(FLOOR(CAST(ClientIP AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 65536) AS BIGINT)) AS nets FROM hits GROUP BY UserID ORDER BY nets DESC, UserID LIMIT 50), r AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT RegionID) AS regions, COUNT(DISTINCT RefererRegionID) AS ref_regions, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits WHERE UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM u) GROUP BY UserID) SELECT u.UserID, u.nets, r.regions, r.ref_regions, r.hit_count FROM u INNER JOIN r ON u.UserID = r.UserID ORDER BY u.nets DESC, u.UserID LIMIT 50
translations.q065: SELECT UserAgent, COUNT(DISTINCT UserAgentMinor) AS minor_versions, COUNT(*) AS hits, MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(UserAgentMinor)) AS max_minor_len FROM hits GROUP BY UserAgent HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserAgentMinor) >= 3 ORDER BY minor_versions DESC, UserAgent LIMIT 30
translations.q066: WITH raven AS (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) AS hr, ClientIP, COUNT(*) AS refreshes FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 1 GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER), ClientIP), ranked AS (SELECT hr, ClientIP, refreshes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hr ORDER BY refreshes DESC, ClientIP) AS rn FROM raven) SELECT hr, ClientIP, refreshes, rn FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY hr, rn
translations.q067: SELECT CAST(NetMajor AS VARCHAR) || '.' || CAST(NetMinor AS VARCHAR) AS net_version, SUM(CASE WHEN EventDate <= '2013-07-07' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_week, SUM(CASE WHEN EventDate >= '2013-07-25' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_week, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits WHERE NetMajor > 0 GROUP BY NetMajor, NetMinor ORDER BY hit_count, NetMajor, NetMinor LIMIT 20
translations.q068: WITH user_day AS (SELECT UserID, EventDate, MIN(EventTime) AS t_first, MAX(EventTime) AS t_last, COUNT(*) AS n FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 0 GROUP BY UserID, EventDate), spans AS (SELECT n, (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t_last) * 60 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM t_last)) - (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t_first) * 60 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM t_first)) AS span_min FROM user_day) SELECT CASE WHEN span_min < 1 THEN 0 WHEN span_min < 10 THEN 1 WHEN span_min < 30 THEN 10 WHEN span_min < 60 THEN 30 WHEN span_min < 180 THEN 60 ELSE 180 END AS span_from_min, COUNT(*) AS user_days, SUM(n) AS hits_total, MAX(n) AS max_hits FROM spans GROUP BY span_from_min ORDER BY span_from_min
translations.q069: SELECT device, BrowserLanguage, users_cnt, rn FROM (SELECT device, BrowserLanguage, users_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY users_cnt DESC, BrowserLanguage) AS rn FROM (SELECT IsMobile AS device, BrowserLanguage, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_cnt FROM hits WHERE BrowserLanguage <> '' GROUP BY IsMobile, BrowserLanguage) t) r WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY device, rn
translations.q070: WITH harbor AS (SELECT ClientIP, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, SUM(IsRefresh) AS refreshes FROM hits GROUP BY ClientIP HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500), lagoon AS (SELECT ClientIP, COUNT(DISTINCT UserAgent) AS agents, COUNT(DISTINCT OS) AS oses, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY ClientIP HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserAgent) >= 2) SELECT h.ClientIP, h.hit_count, h.refreshes, l.agents, l.oses, l.users, ROUND(CAST(h.refreshes AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / h.hit_count, 4) AS refresh_rate FROM harbor h JOIN lagoon l ON h.ClientIP = l.ClientIP ORDER BY l.agents DESC, l.oses DESC, h.hit_count DESC, h.ClientIP LIMIT 25
translations.q071: SELECT user_group, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, ROUND(AVG(IsNotBounce), 4) AS not_bounce_rate, ROUND(AVG(IsDownload), 6) AS download_rate FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE FromTag <> '') THEN 'tagged_user' ELSE 'untagged_user' END AS user_group, UserID, IsNotBounce, IsDownload FROM hits) t GROUP BY user_group ORDER BY user_group
translations.q072: SELECT OS, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, AVG(ResolutionDepth) AS avg_depth, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY OS HAVING AVG(ResolutionDepth) > (SELECT AVG(ResolutionDepth) FROM hits) AND COUNT(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, OS LIMIT 30
translations.q073: WITH slow_pairs AS (SELECT OS, NetMajor FROM hits WHERE DNSTiming > 50 GROUP BY OS, NetMajor INTERSECT SELECT OS, NetMajor FROM hits WHERE ResponseStartTiming > 500 GROUP BY OS, NetMajor) SELECT h.OS AS os_code, h.NetMajor AS net_major, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, ROUND(AVG(h.DNSTiming), 2) AS avg_dns, ROUND(AVG(h.ResponseStartTiming), 2) AS avg_rst FROM hits h JOIN slow_pairs s ON h.OS = s.OS AND h.NetMajor = s.NetMajor GROUP BY h.OS, h.NetMajor ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, os_code, net_major LIMIT 30
translations.q074: SELECT CAST(FlashMajor AS VARCHAR) || '.' || FlashMinor2 AS flash_version, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits WHERE FlashMajor > 0 GROUP BY CAST(FlashMajor AS VARCHAR) || '.' || FlashMinor2 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY users DESC, flash_version LIMIT 25
translations.q075: SELECT OS, SilverlightVersion1, users FROM (SELECT OS, SilverlightVersion1, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OS ORDER BY users DESC, SilverlightVersion1) AS rn FROM (SELECT OS, SilverlightVersion1, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE SilverlightVersion1 > 0 GROUP BY OS, SilverlightVersion1) a) b WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY OS, rn LIMIT 100
translations.q076: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, SUM(CASE WHEN IsMobile = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mobile_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN IsMobile = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS desktop_hits FROM hits WHERE CounterID = (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1) GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) ORDER BY hr
translations.q077: SELECT EventDate, CounterID, mobile_users, rn FROM (SELECT EventDate, CounterID, mobile_users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY mobile_users DESC, CounterID) AS rn FROM (SELECT EventDate, CounterID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS mobile_users FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY EventDate, CounterID) a) b WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY EventDate, rn
translations.q078: WITH daily AS (SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS d, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) + 1 AS next_d, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, SUM(CASE WHEN IsRefresh = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refreshes FROM hits GROUP BY d, next_d) SELECT a.d, a.hit_count, a.refreshes, CAST(a.hit_count AS BIGINT) - CAST(COALESCE(b.hit_count, 0) AS BIGINT) AS delta_hits FROM daily a LEFT JOIN daily b ON a.d = b.next_d ORDER BY a.d
translations.q079: SELECT user_sex, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(CASE WHEN active_days >= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loyal_users, AVG(active_days) AS avg_active_days, MAX(active_days) AS max_active_days FROM (SELECT UserID, MAX(Sex) AS user_sex, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) u GROUP BY user_sex ORDER BY user_sex
translations.q080: SELECT traffic, hr, c AS hit_count FROM (SELECT 'search' AS traffic, hr, c FROM (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE SearchEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) ORDER BY c DESC, hr LIMIT 3) a UNION ALL SELECT 'direct' AS traffic, hr, c FROM (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE SearchEngineID = 0 AND AdvEngineID = 0 AND Referer = '' GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) ORDER BY c DESC, hr LIMIT 3) b UNION ALL SELECT 'refresh' AS traffic, hr, c FROM (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 1 GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) ORDER BY c DESC, hr LIMIT 3) r) u ORDER BY traffic, hit_count DESC, hr
translations.q081: SELECT SilverlightVersion1, SilverlightVersion2, SilverlightVersion3, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE SilverlightVersion3 > 0 GROUP BY SilverlightVersion1, SilverlightVersion2, SilverlightVersion3 HAVING COUNT(*) * 10000 < (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hits WHERE SilverlightVersion3 > 0) ORDER BY hit_count DESC, SilverlightVersion1, SilverlightVersion2, SilverlightVersion3 LIMIT 30
translations.q082: SELECT scheme, length_band, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, ROUND(AVG(IsNotBounce), 4) AS not_bounce_rate FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN Referer = '' THEN 'none' WHEN Referer LIKE 'https://%' THEN 'https' WHEN Referer LIKE 'http://%' THEN 'http' ELSE 'other' END AS scheme, CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(Referer) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(Referer) <= 50 THEN 1 WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(Referer) <= 200 THEN 2 WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(Referer) <= 1000 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS length_band, IsNotBounce FROM hits) t GROUP BY scheme, length_band ORDER BY scheme, length_band
translations.q083: WITH per_user AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits GROUP BY UserID), by_days AS (SELECT active_days, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(hits_cnt) AS total_hits FROM per_user GROUP BY active_days) SELECT active_days, users, total_hits, CAST(total_hits AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(users, 0) AS hits_per_user, SUM(users) OVER (ORDER BY active_days DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS users_with_at_least FROM by_days ORDER BY active_days
translations.q084: SELECT rr, hit_count, cum_hits, CAST(cum_hits AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hits) AS cum_share FROM (SELECT rr, hit_count, SUM(hit_count) OVER (ORDER BY hit_count DESC, rr ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_hits FROM (SELECT RefererRegionID AS rr, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits GROUP BY RefererRegionID) g) w ORDER BY hit_count DESC, rr LIMIT 30
translations.q085: SELECT breadth, COUNT(*) AS user_days, ROUND(AVG(hits_cnt), 2) AS avg_hits, ROUND(AVG(events_cnt), 2) AS avg_events FROM (SELECT UserID, EventDate, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT URLCategoryID) AS cats, SUM(IsEvent) AS events_cnt, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT URLCategoryID) = 1 THEN 'single' WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT URLCategoryID) <= 3 THEN 'few' ELSE 'many' END AS breadth FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, EventDate) d GROUP BY breadth ORDER BY user_days DESC, breadth
translations.q086: WITH harbor AS (SELECT OpenstatServiceName, OpenstatSourceID, COUNT(DISTINCT ClientIP) AS ips, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits GROUP BY OpenstatServiceName, OpenstatSourceID), ranked AS (SELECT OpenstatServiceName, OpenstatSourceID, ips, hit_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OpenstatServiceName ORDER BY ips DESC, hit_count DESC, OpenstatSourceID) AS rn FROM harbor) SELECT OpenstatServiceName, OpenstatSourceID, ips, hit_count, rn FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY ips DESC, OpenstatServiceName, rn LIMIT 60
translations.q087: WITH daily AS (SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS day_num, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS dau FROM hits GROUP BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)), shifted AS (SELECT day_num + 1 AS next_day, dau AS prev_dau FROM daily) SELECT d.day_num, d.dau, s.prev_dau, CAST(d.dau AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(s.prev_dau, 0) AS dau_ratio FROM daily d JOIN shifted s ON d.day_num = s.next_day ORDER BY d.day_num
translations.q088: SELECT NetMajor, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, ROUND(AVG(DNSTiming), 2) AS avg_dns FROM hits WHERE UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits GROUP BY UserID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT TraficSourceID) >= 3) GROUP BY NetMajor ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, NetMajor LIMIT 20
translations.q089: SELECT tabs_bucket, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(hits_cnt) AS total_hits, ROUND(AVG(hid_cnt), 2) AS avg_distinct_hid FROM (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT HID) AS hid_cnt, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT WindowName) = 1 THEN 1 WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT WindowName) <= 3 THEN 2 WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT WindowName) <= 10 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS tabs_bucket FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) t GROUP BY tabs_bucket ORDER BY tabs_bucket
translations.q090: WITH c AS (SELECT UserAgent, UserAgentMinor, COUNT(*) AS hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE UserAgentMinor <> '' GROUP BY UserAgent, UserAgentMinor), r AS (SELECT UserAgent, UserAgentMinor, hits, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserAgent ORDER BY users DESC, hits DESC, UserAgentMinor) AS rn FROM c) SELECT UserAgent, UserAgentMinor, hits, users, rn FROM r WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY UserAgent, rn LIMIT 60
translations.q091: SELECT stage, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, ROUND(AVG(DNSTiming), 2) AS avg_dns, ROUND(AVG(ConnectTiming), 2) AS avg_connect FROM (SELECT DNSTiming, ConnectTiming, CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) = 1 THEN 1 WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) <= 5 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS stage FROM hits WHERE EventDate = '2013-07-15') t GROUP BY stage ORDER BY stage
translations.q092: SELECT RefererRegionID, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ClientIP) AS ips FROM hits WHERE ClientIP IN (SELECT ClientIP FROM hits GROUP BY ClientIP HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT RegionID) >= 2) GROUP BY RefererRegionID ORDER BY hit_count DESC, RefererRegionID LIMIT 20
translations.q093: SELECT CASE WHEN rr_cnt >= 10 THEN 10 ELSE rr_cnt END AS regions_bucket, COUNT(*) AS ips, SUM(hit_count) AS hit_count FROM (SELECT ClientIP, COUNT(DISTINCT RefererRegionID) AS rr_cnt, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits GROUP BY ClientIP) t GROUP BY regions_bucket ORDER BY regions_bucket
translations.q094: WITH s AS (SELECT SocialSourceNetworkID AS net_id, CAST(FLOOR(CAST(ClientIP AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 65536) AS BIGINT) AS ip16, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits WHERE SocialSourceNetworkID <> 0 GROUP BY SocialSourceNetworkID, ip16), r AS (SELECT net_id, ip16, users, hit_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY net_id ORDER BY users DESC, hit_count DESC, ip16) AS rn FROM s) SELECT net_id, ip16, users, hit_count FROM r WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY net_id, rn LIMIT 100
translations.q095: SELECT CASE WHEN URL LIKE '%://m.%' OR URL LIKE '%://mobile.%' THEN 'm_site' ELSE 'full_site' END AS site_kind, SUM(CASE WHEN IsMobile = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mobile_device_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN IsMobile = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS desktop_device_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_cnt, AVG(CHAR_LENGTH(URL)) AS avg_url_len FROM hits WHERE URL <> '' GROUP BY CASE WHEN URL LIKE '%://m.%' OR URL LIKE '%://mobile.%' THEN 'm_site' ELSE 'full_site' END ORDER BY site_kind
translations.q096: SELECT a.RegionID AS region, a.n AS ref_hits, b.n AS direct_hits, a.avg_send AS ref_avg_send, b.avg_send AS direct_avg_send FROM (SELECT RegionID, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(SendTiming), 1) AS avg_send FROM hits WHERE Referer <> '' GROUP BY RegionID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000) a JOIN (SELECT RegionID, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(SendTiming), 1) AS avg_send FROM hits WHERE Referer = '' GROUP BY RegionID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000) b ON a.RegionID = b.RegionID ORDER BY a.n + b.n DESC, a.RegionID LIMIT 20
translations.q097: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, SUM(IsNotBounce) AS not_bounces FROM hits WHERE EventDate = (SELECT EventDate FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate ORDER BY COUNT(*), EventDate LIMIT 1) GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) ORDER BY hr
translations.q098: WITH b AS (SELECT CAST(FLOOR(ResolutionWidth / 320.0) AS INTEGER) * 320 AS w_bucket, SearchEngineID, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE SearchEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY CAST(FLOOR(ResolutionWidth / 320.0) AS INTEGER) * 320, SearchEngineID), r AS (SELECT w_bucket, SearchEngineID, c, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w_bucket ORDER BY users DESC, c DESC, SearchEngineID) AS rn FROM b) SELECT w_bucket, SearchEngineID, users, c AS hit_count, rn FROM r WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY w_bucket, rn LIMIT 100
translations.q099: SELECT CASE WHEN users_per_funiq >= 10 THEN 10 ELSE users_per_funiq END AS sharing_level, COUNT(*) AS funiqs, SUM(hit_count) AS total_hits FROM (SELECT FUniqID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_per_funiq, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits WHERE FUniqID <> 0 GROUP BY FUniqID) t GROUP BY CASE WHEN users_per_funiq >= 10 THEN 10 ELSE users_per_funiq END ORDER BY sharing_level
translations.q100: SELECT d.RegionID AS region_id, d.hits_cnt AS desktop_hits, m.hits_cnt AS mobile_hits, ROUND(d.avg_rst, 2) AS desktop_rst, ROUND(m.avg_rst, 2) AS mobile_rst FROM (SELECT RegionID, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS avg_rst FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 0 GROUP BY RegionID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000) d JOIN (SELECT RegionID, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS avg_rst FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY RegionID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100) m ON d.RegionID = m.RegionID ORDER BY m.hits_cnt DESC, d.RegionID LIMIT 20

translations.q001: WITH uh AS (SELECT UserID, EventDate, COUNT(DISTINCT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)) AS hours_active FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, EventDate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)) >= 16), ua AS (SELECT UserID, MAX(Age) AS max_age FROM hits WHERE UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM uh) GROUP BY UserID) SELECT age_band, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(*) AS user_days, MAX(hours_active) AS max_hours FROM (SELECT uh.UserID, uh.hours_active, CASE WHEN ua.max_age = 0 THEN 'unknown' WHEN ua.max_age < 25 THEN 'young' WHEN ua.max_age < 45 THEN 'middle' ELSE 'senior' END AS age_band FROM uh JOIN ua ON uh.UserID = ua.UserID) t GROUP BY age_band ORDER BY age_band
translations.q002: WITH net AS (SELECT CAST(FLOOR(CAST(ClientIP AS DOUBLE) / 256) AS BIGINT) AS ip24, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, SUM(CASE WHEN IsRefresh = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refreshes, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY ip24 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2000), sus AS (SELECT ip24, hit_count, refreshes, users FROM net ORDER BY CAST(refreshes AS DOUBLE) / hit_count DESC, ip24 LIMIT 20), reg AS (SELECT CAST(FLOOR(CAST(ClientIP AS DOUBLE) / 256) AS BIGINT) AS ip24, RefererRegionID AS rr, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE CAST(FLOOR(CAST(ClientIP AS DOUBLE) / 256) AS BIGINT) IN (SELECT ip24 FROM sus) GROUP BY ip24, rr), ranked AS (SELECT ip24, rr, c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ip24 ORDER BY c DESC, rr) AS rn FROM reg) SELECT s.ip24, s.hit_count, s.refreshes, s.users, r.rr AS top_ref_region, r.c AS top_ref_hits FROM sus s INNER JOIN ranked r ON s.ip24 = r.ip24 WHERE r.rn = 1 ORDER BY CAST(s.refreshes AS DOUBLE) / s.hit_count DESC, s.ip24
translations.q003: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) FROM hits WHERE IsDownload = 1) AS downloaders, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS downloaders_never_engaged FROM hits h WHERE h.IsDownload = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits x WHERE x.UserID = h.UserID AND x.IsNotBounce = 1) ORDER BY downloaders
translations.q004: WITH lagoon AS (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER) AS dom, Title, COUNT(DISTINCT ClientIP) AS ips, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits WHERE Title <> '' AND CHAR_LENGTH(Title) <= 10 GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER), Title), ranked AS (SELECT dom, Title, ips, hit_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dom ORDER BY ips DESC, hit_count DESC, Title) AS rn FROM lagoon) SELECT dom, Title, CHAR_LENGTH(Title) AS title_len, ips, hit_count, rn FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY dom, rn LIMIT 100
translations.q005: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-07' GROUP BY CounterID EXCEPT SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-25' GROUP BY CounterID) a) AS faded_counters, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-25' GROUP BY CounterID EXCEPT SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-07' GROUP BY CounterID) b) AS emerging_counters, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CounterID) FROM hits) AS all_counters ORDER BY faded_counters
translations.q006: WITH ip_stats AS (SELECT ClientIP, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY ClientIP HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500), timed AS (SELECT ClientIP FROM hits WHERE ConnectTiming > 0 GROUP BY ClientIP) SELECT s.ClientIP, s.hit_count, s.users FROM ip_stats s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM timed t WHERE t.ClientIP = s.ClientIP) ORDER BY s.hit_count DESC, s.ClientIP LIMIT 20
translations.q007: SELECT IsMobile, gap_band, COUNT(*) AS gaps FROM (SELECT IsMobile, CASE WHEN nxt - cur = 0 THEN 0 WHEN nxt - cur <= 5 THEN 1 WHEN nxt - cur <= 30 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS gap_band FROM (SELECT IsMobile, minute_of_day AS cur, LEAD(minute_of_day, 1, -1) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID, IsMobile ORDER BY EventTime ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS nxt FROM (SELECT UserID, IsMobile, EventTime, CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) AS minute_of_day FROM hits WHERE EventDate = '2013-07-15') x) s WHERE nxt >= 0) g GROUP BY IsMobile, gap_band ORDER BY IsMobile, gap_band
translations.q008: WITH user_activity AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits GROUP BY UserID), top_users AS (SELECT UserID, active_days, hits_cnt FROM user_activity ORDER BY active_days DESC, hits_cnt DESC, UserID LIMIT 20), user_os AS (SELECT UserID, OS, COUNT(*) AS os_hits FROM hits WHERE UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM top_users) GROUP BY UserID, OS), os_ranked AS (SELECT UserID, OS, os_hits, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY os_hits DESC, OS) AS rn FROM user_os) SELECT t.UserID, t.active_days, t.hits_cnt, o.OS AS main_os, o.os_hits FROM top_users t JOIN os_ranked o ON t.UserID = o.UserID WHERE o.rn = 1 ORDER BY t.active_days DESC, t.hits_cnt DESC, t.UserID
translations.q009: SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT 20 * AVG(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID) t) ORDER BY hits DESC, CounterID LIMIT 25
translations.q010: SELECT OS, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN MobilePhone > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS phone_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN CookieEnable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nocookie_hits FROM hits WHERE OS IN (SELECT OS FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OS FROM hits WHERE MobilePhone > 0 INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT OS FROM hits WHERE CookieEnable = 0) x) GROUP BY OS ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, OS LIMIT 25
translations.q011: WITH daily AS (SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS total_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN IsMobile = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mobile_hits FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate) SELECT EventDate, mobile_hits, total_hits, CAST(mobile_hits AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(total_hits, 0) AS mobile_share, mobile_hits - (SELECT AVG(mobile_hits) FROM daily) AS vs_avg_mobile, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY mobile_hits DESC) AS mobile_rank FROM daily ORDER BY EventDate
translations.q012: WITH nd AS (SELECT CAST(FLOOR(CAST(ClientIP AS DOUBLE) / 65536) AS BIGINT) AS ip16, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS d, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits GROUP BY ip16, d) SELECT n.ip16, SUM(n.hit_count) AS early_hits, COUNT(*) AS early_days FROM nd n WHERE n.d <= 3 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nd m WHERE m.ip16 = n.ip16 AND m.d >= 29) GROUP BY n.ip16 ORDER BY early_hits DESC, n.ip16 LIMIT 20
translations.q013: SELECT LOWER(SUBSTRING(BrowserLanguage, 1, 2)) AS lang_prefix, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN SearchEngineID <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS search_hits FROM hits WHERE BrowserLanguage <> '' GROUP BY LOWER(SUBSTRING(BrowserLanguage, 1, 2)) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 ORDER BY users_cnt DESC, hits_cnt DESC, lang_prefix LIMIT 15
translations.q014: WITH src AS (SELECT OpenstatSourceID, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_cnt FROM hits WHERE OpenstatSourceID <> '' GROUP BY OpenstatSourceID), src_os AS (SELECT OpenstatSourceID, OS, COUNT(*) AS os_hits, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OpenstatSourceID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, OS) AS rn FROM hits WHERE OpenstatSourceID <> '' GROUP BY OpenstatSourceID, OS) SELECT s.OpenstatSourceID, s.hits_cnt, s.users_cnt, o.OS AS top_os, CAST(o.os_hits AS DOUBLE) / s.hits_cnt AS top_os_share FROM src s JOIN src_os o ON s.OpenstatSourceID = o.OpenstatSourceID WHERE o.rn = 1 ORDER BY s.hits_cnt DESC, s.users_cnt DESC, s.OpenstatSourceID LIMIT 15
translations.q015: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OS, ResolutionDepth FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-16' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT OS, ResolutionDepth FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-16') a) AS only_first_half, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OS, ResolutionDepth FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-16' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT OS, ResolutionDepth FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-16') b) AS only_second_half, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT OS, ResolutionDepth FROM hits) c) AS all_pairs ORDER BY only_first_half
translations.q016: SELECT day_of_month, new_ips, one_hit_ips, SUM(new_ips) OVER (ORDER BY day_of_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_ips FROM (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM first_day) AS INTEGER) AS day_of_month, COUNT(*) AS new_ips, SUM(CASE WHEN total_hits = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS one_hit_ips FROM (SELECT ClientIP, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day, COUNT(*) AS total_hits FROM hits GROUP BY ClientIP) t GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM first_day) AS INTEGER)) d ORDER BY day_of_month
translations.q017: SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hits, AVG(CHAR_LENGTH(Title)) AS avg_title_len, MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(Title)) AS max_title_len, COUNT(DISTINCT Title) AS titles FROM hits WHERE Title <> '' AND CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY c DESC, CounterID LIMIT 10) t) GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY avg_title_len DESC, CounterID
translations.q018: WITH hourly AS (SELECT TraficSourceID, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS avg_rst FROM hits GROUP BY TraficSourceID, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100), ranked AS (SELECT TraficSourceID, hr, hits_cnt, avg_rst, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TraficSourceID ORDER BY avg_rst DESC, hr) AS rn FROM hourly) SELECT TraficSourceID, hr, hits_cnt, ROUND(avg_rst, 2) AS avg_rst_ms, rn FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY TraficSourceID, rn
translations.q019: SELECT CASE WHEN h.IsMobile = 1 THEN 'mobile' ELSE 'desktop' END AS device, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users_cnt, AVG(h.WindowClientWidth) AS avg_width FROM hits h WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits g WHERE g.UserID = h.UserID AND g.HasGCLID = 1) GROUP BY h.IsMobile ORDER BY device
translations.q020: WITH vis AS (SELECT RegionID AS reg, COUNT(*) AS visitor_hits FROM hits GROUP BY RegionID), ref AS (SELECT RefererRegionID AS reg, COUNT(*) AS referer_hits FROM hits WHERE RefererRegionID <> 0 GROUP BY RefererRegionID), k AS (SELECT reg FROM (SELECT reg FROM vis UNION ALL SELECT reg FROM ref) x GROUP BY reg) SELECT k.reg, COALESCE(v.visitor_hits, 0) AS visitor_hits, COALESCE(f.referer_hits, 0) AS referer_hits, COALESCE(v.visitor_hits, 0) + COALESCE(f.referer_hits, 0) AS total_hits FROM k LEFT JOIN vis v ON k.reg = v.reg LEFT JOIN ref f ON k.reg = f.reg ORDER BY total_hits DESC, k.reg LIMIT 30
translations.q021: WITH first_seen AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID), weekly AS (SELECT CAST(FLOOR(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) - 1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 7) AS INTEGER) + 1 AS wk, COUNT(*) AS hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY CAST(FLOOR(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) - 1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 7) AS INTEGER) + 1), newbies AS (SELECT CAST(FLOOR(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM first_day) - 1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 7) AS INTEGER) + 1 AS wk, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM first_seen GROUP BY CAST(FLOOR(CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM first_day) - 1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 7) AS INTEGER) + 1) SELECT w.wk, w.hits, w.users, COALESCE(n.new_users, 0) AS new_users, CAST(COALESCE(n.new_users, 0) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(w.users, 0) AS new_user_share FROM weekly w LEFT JOIN newbies n ON n.wk = w.wk ORDER BY w.wk
translations.q022: SELECT SUBSTRING(URL, 1, 25) AS url_prefix, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ClientIP) AS ips FROM hits WHERE ClientIP IN (SELECT ClientIP FROM (SELECT ClientIP, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS u FROM hits GROUP BY ClientIP ORDER BY u DESC, ClientIP LIMIT 10) t) AND URL <> '' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(URL, 1, 25) ORDER BY hit_count DESC, url_prefix LIMIT 30
translations.q023: SELECT h.EventDate, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS lapsed_searchers, COUNT(*) AS search_hits FROM hits h WHERE h.SearchPhrase <> '' AND h.EventDate BETWEEN DATE '2013-07-01' AND DATE '2013-07-07' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits l WHERE l.UserID = h.UserID AND l.EventDate >= DATE '2013-07-15') GROUP BY h.EventDate ORDER BY h.EventDate
translations.q024: WITH user_counter AS (SELECT CounterID, UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID, UserID), counter_stats AS (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(CASE WHEN active_days >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ret_users FROM user_counter GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100) SELECT FLOOR(CAST(ret_users * 10 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / users) AS retention_decile, COUNT(*) AS counters, SUM(users) AS users_total FROM counter_stats GROUP BY retention_decile ORDER BY retention_decile
translations.q025: WITH top_counter AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1), seq AS (SELECT UserID, EventTime, LEAD(EventTime) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) AS nxt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime DESC, WatchID DESC) AS rn_desc FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM top_counter) AND EventDate >= '2013-07-01' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-31'), gaps AS (SELECT (EXTRACT(DAY FROM nxt) - EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventTime)) * 86400 + (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM nxt) - EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)) * 3600 + (EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM nxt) - EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM EventTime)) * 60 + (EXTRACT(SECOND FROM nxt) - EXTRACT(SECOND FROM EventTime)) AS gap FROM seq WHERE rn_desc > 1) SELECT CASE WHEN gap < 10 THEN 1 WHEN gap < 60 THEN 2 WHEN gap < 3600 THEN 3 WHEN gap < 86400 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS gap_band, COUNT(*) AS n FROM gaps GROUP BY CASE WHEN gap < 10 THEN 1 WHEN gap < 60 THEN 2 WHEN gap < 3600 THEN 3 WHEN gap < 86400 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END ORDER BY gap_band
translations.q026: SELECT OS, ResolutionDepth, hits_cnt, rn FROM (SELECT OS, ResolutionDepth, hits_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OS ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, ResolutionDepth) AS rn FROM (SELECT OS, ResolutionDepth, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits WHERE OS IN (SELECT OS FROM hits GROUP BY OS ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, OS LIMIT 10) GROUP BY OS, ResolutionDepth) a) t WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY OS, rn
translations.q027: SELECT SearchEngineID, COUNT(*) AS searches, COUNT(DISTINCT SearchPhrase) AS phrases, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS searchers, SUM(CASE WHEN SearchPhrase LIKE '% % %' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS long_queries, MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(SearchPhrase)) AS max_len FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY SearchEngineID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY searches DESC, SearchEngineID LIMIT 20
translations.q028: WITH only_search AS (SELECT BrowserCountry FROM hits WHERE SearchEngineID <> 0 AND BrowserCountry <> '' GROUP BY BrowserCountry EXCEPT SELECT BrowserCountry FROM hits WHERE UTMSource <> '' GROUP BY BrowserCountry) SELECT h.BrowserCountry, COUNT(*) AS search_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS search_users FROM hits h JOIN only_search o ON h.BrowserCountry = o.BrowserCountry WHERE h.SearchEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY h.BrowserCountry ORDER BY search_hits DESC, search_users DESC, h.BrowserCountry LIMIT 20
translations.q029: WITH h AS (SELECT NetMajor AS nm, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(DISTINCT ClientIP) AS ips, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 1 GROUP BY NetMajor, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)) SELECT nm, hr, ips, hit_count FROM (SELECT nm, hr, ips, hit_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY nm ORDER BY ips DESC, hit_count DESC, hr) AS rn FROM h) t WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY nm, rn LIMIT 100
translations.q030: WITH cs AS (SELECT CounterID, AVG(FetchTiming) AS avg_f, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000), outl AS (SELECT h.CounterID, COUNT(*) AS slow_cnt FROM hits h JOIN cs ON h.CounterID = cs.CounterID WHERE h.FetchTiming > 3 * cs.avg_f GROUP BY h.CounterID) SELECT cs.CounterID, cs.hits_cnt, o.slow_cnt, CAST(o.slow_cnt AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(cs.hits_cnt, 0) AS slow_share FROM cs JOIN outl o ON cs.CounterID = o.CounterID ORDER BY slow_share DESC, cs.CounterID LIMIT 20
translations.q031: WITH trav AS (SELECT UserID FROM hits GROUP BY UserID ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT RegionID) DESC, UserID LIMIT 10) SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS n_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN rn > 1 AND prev_region <> RegionID THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS region_switches FROM (SELECT UserID, RegionID, LAG(RegionID) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) AS prev_region, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) AS rn FROM hits WHERE UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM trav)) t GROUP BY UserID ORDER BY region_switches DESC, UserID
translations.q032: SELECT metric, hits_cnt, nonzero_hits, avg_ms, max_ms FROM (SELECT 'dns' AS metric, 1 AS ord, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN DNSTiming > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonzero_hits, ROUND(AVG(DNSTiming), 2) AS avg_ms, MAX(DNSTiming) AS max_ms FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-08' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-21' UNION ALL SELECT 'connect', 2, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN ConnectTiming > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ROUND(AVG(ConnectTiming), 2), MAX(ConnectTiming) FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-08' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-21' UNION ALL SELECT 'send', 3, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN SendTiming > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ROUND(AVG(SendTiming), 2), MAX(SendTiming) FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-08' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-21' UNION ALL SELECT 'response_start', 4, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN ResponseStartTiming > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ROUND(AVG(ResponseStartTiming), 2), MAX(ResponseStartTiming) FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-08' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-21' UNION ALL SELECT 'response_end', 5, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN ResponseEndTiming > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ROUND(AVG(ResponseEndTiming), 2), MAX(ResponseEndTiming) FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-08' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-21' UNION ALL SELECT 'fetch', 6, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN FetchTiming > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), ROUND(AVG(FetchTiming), 2), MAX(FetchTiming) FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-08' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-21') m ORDER BY ord
translations.q033: WITH daily AS (SELECT TraficSourceID, EventDate, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM hits GROUP BY TraficSourceID, EventDate) SELECT d.TraficSourceID, d.EventDate, d.hits FROM daily d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM daily p WHERE p.TraficSourceID = d.TraficSourceID AND p.EventDate < d.EventDate AND p.hits >= d.hits) ORDER BY d.TraficSourceID, d.EventDate LIMIT 100
translations.q034: WITH per_user AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT ClientIP) AS ips FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) SELECT COUNT(*) AS heavy_users, COALESCE(SUM(c), 0) AS heavy_hits, COALESCE(MAX(c), 0) AS max_hits, COALESCE(MAX(ips), 0) AS max_ips FROM per_user WHERE c > 50 * (SELECT AVG(c) FROM per_user) ORDER BY heavy_users
translations.q035: SELECT CounterClass, CounterID, hits_cnt, avg_fetch_ms, rn FROM (SELECT CounterClass, CounterID, hits_cnt, avg_fetch_ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CounterClass ORDER BY avg_fetch DESC, CounterID) AS rn FROM (SELECT CounterClass, CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, AVG(FetchTiming) AS avg_fetch, ROUND(AVG(FetchTiming), 2) AS avg_fetch_ms FROM hits GROUP BY CounterClass, CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000) a) t WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY CounterClass, rn LIMIT 100
translations.q036: WITH daily AS (SELECT RegionID, EventDate, COUNT(*) AS n FROM hits GROUP BY RegionID, EventDate), stats AS (SELECT RegionID, MAX(n) AS mx, SUM(n) AS tot, COUNT(*) AS days FROM daily GROUP BY RegionID), bursty AS (SELECT RegionID FROM stats WHERE days >= 3 AND mx * 2 > tot) SELECT d.RegionID AS region, d.EventDate AS burst_day, d.n AS burst_hits, s.tot AS region_hits, s.days AS active_days FROM daily d JOIN stats s ON d.RegionID = s.RegionID WHERE d.n = s.mx AND d.RegionID IN (SELECT RegionID FROM bursty) ORDER BY burst_hits DESC, region, burst_day LIMIT 30
translations.q037: SELECT first_char, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT FromTag) AS tags, ROUND(AVG(CHAR_LENGTH(FromTag)), 2) AS avg_len FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN FromTag = '' THEN '(none)' ELSE UPPER(SUBSTRING(FromTag, 1, 1)) END AS first_char, FromTag FROM hits) t GROUP BY first_char ORDER BY hit_count DESC, first_char LIMIT 20
translations.q038: WITH lagoon AS (SELECT ClientIP FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY ClientIP INTERSECT SELECT ClientIP FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 0 AND ResolutionWidth >= 1600 GROUP BY ClientIP) SELECT h.ClientIP, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users, SUM(h.IsMobile) AS mobile_hits FROM hits h JOIN lagoon l ON h.ClientIP = l.ClientIP GROUP BY h.ClientIP ORDER BY hit_count DESC, h.ClientIP LIMIT 20
translations.q039: WITH daily AS (SELECT UserAgent, EventDate, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM hits GROUP BY UserAgent, EventDate) SELECT d.UserAgent, COUNT(*) AS strong_days, MAX(d.hits) AS peak_hits, MIN(d.EventDate) AS first_strong_day FROM daily d WHERE d.hits > 1.2 * (SELECT AVG(d2.hits) FROM daily d2 WHERE d2.UserAgent = d.UserAgent) GROUP BY d.UserAgent ORDER BY strong_days DESC, d.UserAgent LIMIT 20
translations.q040: WITH g AS (SELECT UserAgent, UserAgentMinor, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE UserAgentMinor <> '' GROUP BY UserAgent, UserAgentMinor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5), r AS (SELECT UserAgent, UserAgentMinor, c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserAgent ORDER BY c, UserAgentMinor) AS rn FROM g) SELECT UserAgent, UserAgentMinor, c, rn FROM r WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY UserAgent, rn LIMIT 100
translations.q041: WITH hourly AS (SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN HasGCLID = 1 THEN UserID END) AS gclid_users, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS avg_rst FROM hits GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)) SELECT cur.hr AS hour_of_day, cur.hits_cnt AS hits_in_hour, cur.gclid_users AS gclid_users_in_hour, ROUND(cur.avg_rst, 2) AS avg_rst_ms, ROUND(cur.avg_rst - prev.avg_rst, 2) AS delta_vs_prev_hour FROM hourly cur JOIN hourly prev ON cur.hr = prev.hr + 1 ORDER BY hour_of_day
translations.q042: SELECT h.MobilePhone, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits h WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits d WHERE d.UserID = h.UserID AND d.IsDownload = 1) GROUP BY h.MobilePhone ORDER BY users DESC, hit_count DESC, h.MobilePhone LIMIT 30
translations.q043: WITH langs AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage FROM hits WHERE MobilePhone > 0 GROUP BY BrowserLanguage INTERSECT SELECT BrowserLanguage FROM hits WHERE SilverlightVersion3 > 0 GROUP BY BrowserLanguage) SELECT b.BrowserLanguage, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.UserID) AS users FROM hits b WHERE b.BrowserLanguage IN (SELECT BrowserLanguage FROM langs) GROUP BY b.BrowserLanguage ORDER BY hit_count DESC, b.BrowserLanguage LIMIT 30
translations.q044: SELECT UTMMedium, local_hour, hits_cnt FROM (SELECT UTMMedium, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime) AS local_hour, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UTMMedium ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime)) AS rn FROM hits WHERE UTMMedium <> '' GROUP BY UTMMedium, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime)) t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, UTMMedium LIMIT 20
translations.q045: WITH ranked AS (SELECT UserID, TraficSourceID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID, TraficSourceID) AS rn FROM hits), first_touch AS (SELECT UserID, TraficSourceID FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1), activity AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) SELECT f.TraficSourceID, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(CASE WHEN a.active_days >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned_users, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.active_days >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS return_rate FROM first_touch f JOIN activity a ON f.UserID = a.UserID GROUP BY f.TraficSourceID ORDER BY users DESC, f.TraficSourceID
translations.q046: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, SUM(IsRefresh) AS refreshes FROM hits WHERE EventDate = (SELECT EventDate FROM (SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate ORDER BY c DESC, EventDate LIMIT 1) b) GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) ORDER BY hr
translations.q047: SELECT m.MobilePhone, COUNT(DISTINCT m.UserID) AS flashless_users, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits m WHERE m.IsMobile = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits f WHERE f.UserID = m.UserID AND f.FlashMinor2 <> '') GROUP BY m.MobilePhone ORDER BY flashless_users DESC, hits_cnt DESC, m.MobilePhone LIMIT 25
translations.q048: WITH t AS (SELECT IsMobile, Title, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS avg_rst FROM hits WHERE Title <> '' GROUP BY IsMobile, Title HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200), r AS (SELECT IsMobile, Title, hits_cnt, avg_rst, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY IsMobile ORDER BY avg_rst DESC, hits_cnt DESC, Title) AS rn FROM t) SELECT IsMobile, Title, hits_cnt, ROUND(avg_rst, 2) AS avg_rst_ms, rn FROM r WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY IsMobile, rn
translations.q049: SELECT first_day, CASE WHEN (EXTRACT(DAY FROM first_day) - 1) % 7 IN (5, 6) THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'weekday' END AS day_kind, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) t GROUP BY first_day ORDER BY first_day
translations.q050: SELECT UPPER(SUBSTRING(BrowserLanguage, 1, 2)) AS lang_code, COUNT(*) AS desktop_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS cross_device_users FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 0 AND BrowserLanguage <> '' AND UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1) GROUP BY UPPER(SUBSTRING(BrowserLanguage, 1, 2)) ORDER BY cross_device_users DESC, desktop_hits DESC, lang_code LIMIT 20
translations.q051: WITH s AS (SELECT IsMobile, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN JavascriptEnable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS js_off, SUM(HasGCLID) AS gclid, SUM(IsRefresh) AS refreshes, SUM(IsNotBounce) AS engaged FROM hits GROUP BY IsMobile) SELECT ord, metric, IsMobile, rate FROM (SELECT 1 AS ord, 'javascript_off' AS metric, IsMobile, CAST(js_off AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(n, 0) AS rate FROM s UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS ord, 'gclid' AS metric, IsMobile, CAST(gclid AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(n, 0) AS rate FROM s UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS ord, 'refresh' AS metric, IsMobile, CAST(refreshes AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(n, 0) AS rate FROM s UNION ALL SELECT 4 AS ord, 'not_bounce' AS metric, IsMobile, CAST(engaged AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(n, 0) AS rate FROM s) r ORDER BY ord, IsMobile
translations.q052: WITH by_src AS (SELECT EventDate, TraficSourceID, COUNT(*) AS src_hits FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, TraficSourceID), by_day AS (SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS day_hits FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate), shares AS (SELECT s.TraficSourceID AS src_id, s.EventDate AS day_date, s.src_hits AS src_hits, d.day_hits AS day_hits, CAST(s.src_hits AS DOUBLE) / d.day_hits AS day_share FROM by_src s JOIN by_day d ON s.EventDate = d.EventDate), ranked AS (SELECT src_id, day_date, src_hits, day_hits, day_share, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY src_id ORDER BY day_share DESC, day_date) AS rn FROM shares) SELECT src_id, day_date, src_hits, day_hits, day_share FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY src_id
translations.q053: SELECT h.EventDate, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS adv_searchers, COUNT(*) AS adv_hits FROM hits h WHERE h.AdvEngineID <> 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits s WHERE s.UserID = h.UserID AND s.EventDate = h.EventDate AND s.SearchPhrase <> '') GROUP BY h.EventDate ORDER BY h.EventDate
translations.q054: SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM first_day) AS INTEGER) AS day_of_july, new_users, SUM(new_users) OVER (ORDER BY first_day) AS cumulative_users FROM (SELECT first_day, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) u GROUP BY first_day) d ORDER BY first_day
translations.q055: SELECT OS, COUNT(*) AS total_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN JavascriptEnable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nojs_hits, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN JavascriptEnable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hits WHERE JavascriptEnable = 0), 0) AS share_of_nojs FROM hits GROUP BY OS HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY nojs_hits DESC, OS LIMIT 15
translations.q056: WITH mob AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS m_hits, SUM(ConnectTiming) AS m_conn FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY UserID), desk AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS d_hits, SUM(ConnectTiming) AS d_conn FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 0 GROUP BY UserID) SELECT CASE WHEN m.m_conn * d.d_hits > d.d_conn * m.m_hits THEN 1 WHEN m.m_conn * d.d_hits < d.d_conn * m.m_hits THEN -1 ELSE 0 END AS verdict, COUNT(*) AS users_cnt, SUM(m.m_hits) AS mobile_hits, SUM(d.d_hits) AS desktop_hits FROM mob m JOIN desk d ON m.UserID = d.UserID GROUP BY CASE WHEN m.m_conn * d.d_hits > d.d_conn * m.m_hits THEN 1 WHEN m.m_conn * d.d_hits < d.d_conn * m.m_hits THEN -1 ELSE 0 END ORDER BY verdict
translations.q057: SELECT CAST(FLOOR(CAST(LENGTH(Title) AS DOUBLE) / 20) AS INTEGER) * 20 AS len_from, COUNT(*) AS hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, AVG(ResolutionDepth) AS avg_depth FROM hits WHERE Title <> '' GROUP BY CAST(FLOOR(CAST(LENGTH(Title) AS DOUBLE) / 20) AS INTEGER) * 20 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY len_from LIMIT 50
translations.q058: SELECT column_name, distinct_values, filled_hits FROM (SELECT 'UTMMedium' AS column_name, COUNT(DISTINCT UTMMedium) AS distinct_values, SUM(CASE WHEN UTMMedium <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS filled_hits FROM hits UNION ALL SELECT 'OpenstatCampaignID' AS column_name, COUNT(DISTINCT OpenstatCampaignID) AS distinct_values, SUM(CASE WHEN OpenstatCampaignID <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS filled_hits FROM hits UNION ALL SELECT 'FlashMinor2' AS column_name, COUNT(DISTINCT FlashMinor2) AS distinct_values, SUM(CASE WHEN FlashMinor2 <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS filled_hits FROM hits UNION ALL SELECT 'MobilePhoneModel' AS column_name, COUNT(DISTINCT MobilePhoneModel) AS distinct_values, SUM(CASE WHEN MobilePhoneModel <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS filled_hits FROM hits) u ORDER BY column_name
translations.q059: SELECT m.EventDate, COUNT(*) AS mobile_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT m.ClientIP) AS shared_ips FROM hits m WHERE m.IsMobile = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits d WHERE d.IsMobile = 0 AND d.ClientIP = m.ClientIP AND d.EventDate = m.EventDate) GROUP BY m.EventDate ORDER BY m.EventDate
translations.q060: SELECT first_tz, COUNT(*) AS users FROM (SELECT UserID, MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc = 1 THEN ClientTimeZone END) AS first_tz, MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN ClientTimeZone END) AS last_tz FROM (SELECT UserID, ClientTimeZone, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) AS rn_asc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime DESC, WatchID DESC) AS rn_desc FROM hits) s GROUP BY UserID) u WHERE first_tz <> last_tz GROUP BY first_tz ORDER BY users DESC, first_tz LIMIT 30
translations.q061: SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN JavaEnable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS java_off_share FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 AND CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN JavaEnable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) > (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN JavaEnable = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) FROM hits) ORDER BY java_off_share DESC, CounterID LIMIT 20
translations.q062: WITH hourly AS (SELECT EventDate AS day_date, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime) AS local_hour, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, AVG(FetchTiming) AS avg_fetch FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime)), ranked AS (SELECT day_date, local_hour, hits_cnt, avg_fetch, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY day_date ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, local_hour) AS rn FROM hourly) SELECT day_date, local_hour, hits_cnt, ROUND(avg_fetch, 2) AS avg_fetch_ms FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY day_date
translations.q063: SELECT metric, users FROM (SELECT 'flash_users' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE FlashMajor > 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'silverlight_users' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE SilverlightVersion1 > 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'nojs_users' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE JavascriptEnable = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'refreshing_users' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'all_users' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DontCountHits = 0 THEN UserID END) AS users FROM hits) k ORDER BY users DESC, metric
translations.q064: WITH u AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(FLOOR(CAST(ClientIP AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 65536) AS BIGINT)) AS nets FROM hits GROUP BY UserID ORDER BY nets DESC, UserID LIMIT 50), r AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT RegionID) AS regions, COUNT(DISTINCT RefererRegionID) AS ref_regions, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits WHERE UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM u) GROUP BY UserID) SELECT u.UserID, u.nets, r.regions, r.ref_regions, r.hit_count FROM u INNER JOIN r ON u.UserID = r.UserID ORDER BY u.nets DESC, u.UserID LIMIT 50
translations.q065: SELECT UserAgent, COUNT(DISTINCT UserAgentMinor) AS minor_versions, COUNT(*) AS hits, MAX(LENGTH(UserAgentMinor)) AS max_minor_len FROM hits GROUP BY UserAgent HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserAgentMinor) >= 3 ORDER BY minor_versions DESC, UserAgent LIMIT 30
translations.q066: WITH raven AS (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) AS hr, ClientIP, COUNT(*) AS refreshes FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 1 GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER), ClientIP), ranked AS (SELECT hr, ClientIP, refreshes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hr ORDER BY refreshes DESC, ClientIP) AS rn FROM raven) SELECT hr, ClientIP, refreshes, rn FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY hr, rn
translations.q067: SELECT CAST(NetMajor AS VARCHAR) || '.' || CAST(NetMinor AS VARCHAR) AS net_version, SUM(CASE WHEN EventDate <= DATE '2013-07-07' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_week, SUM(CASE WHEN EventDate >= DATE '2013-07-25' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_week, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits WHERE NetMajor > 0 GROUP BY NetMajor, NetMinor ORDER BY hit_count, NetMajor, NetMinor LIMIT 20
translations.q068: WITH user_day AS (SELECT UserID, EventDate, MIN(EventTime) AS t_first, MAX(EventTime) AS t_last, COUNT(*) AS n FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 0 GROUP BY UserID, EventDate), spans AS (SELECT n, (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t_last) * 60 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM t_last)) - (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t_first) * 60 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM t_first)) AS span_min FROM user_day) SELECT CASE WHEN span_min < 1 THEN 0 WHEN span_min < 10 THEN 1 WHEN span_min < 30 THEN 10 WHEN span_min < 60 THEN 30 WHEN span_min < 180 THEN 60 ELSE 180 END AS span_from_min, COUNT(*) AS user_days, SUM(n) AS hits_total, MAX(n) AS max_hits FROM spans GROUP BY span_from_min ORDER BY span_from_min
translations.q069: SELECT device, BrowserLanguage, users_cnt, rn FROM (SELECT device, BrowserLanguage, users_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY users_cnt DESC, BrowserLanguage) AS rn FROM (SELECT IsMobile AS device, BrowserLanguage, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_cnt FROM hits WHERE BrowserLanguage <> '' GROUP BY IsMobile, BrowserLanguage) t) r WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY device, rn
translations.q070: WITH harbor AS (SELECT ClientIP, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, SUM(IsRefresh) AS refreshes FROM hits GROUP BY ClientIP HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500), lagoon AS (SELECT ClientIP, COUNT(DISTINCT UserAgent) AS agents, COUNT(DISTINCT OS) AS oses, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY ClientIP HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserAgent) >= 2) SELECT h.ClientIP, h.hit_count, h.refreshes, l.agents, l.oses, l.users, ROUND(CAST(h.refreshes AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / h.hit_count, 4) AS refresh_rate FROM harbor h JOIN lagoon l ON h.ClientIP = l.ClientIP ORDER BY l.agents DESC, l.oses DESC, h.hit_count DESC, h.ClientIP LIMIT 25
translations.q071: SELECT user_group, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, ROUND(AVG(IsNotBounce), 4) AS not_bounce_rate, ROUND(AVG(IsDownload), 6) AS download_rate FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE FromTag <> '') THEN 'tagged_user' ELSE 'untagged_user' END AS user_group, UserID, IsNotBounce, IsDownload FROM hits) t GROUP BY user_group ORDER BY user_group
